serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What is this?! It looks like some ill-conceived hotdog with an oversized sausage…
The bun is too small and weird…
You: H-How is it? Tasty?
Bot: Yeah. I think. Hard to tell.
Bot: I can analyze its taste, but I don’t really have any preference. It’s just information in my memory.
You: Oh…
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t worry about it. I’m still having fun! Besides, today we both have the same meal so we can exchange our opinions!
You: Right…
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: You haven’t even touched your Wurst, what’s wrong?
You: N-Nothing, it’s just hot. I don’t want to burn myself.
I need to at least taste it…
You: …
You: Damn, it’s actually good. I don't really know what that sour thing is on top, but it really nicely connects the whole thing.
Bot: That’s Sauerkraut, an old cabbage from a barrel.
You: …
Isn’t that a health risk?
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: E-Either way, it was better than I expected.
Bot: Great! We both liked it!
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: What do you want for a dessert? I’m thinking Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte.
…
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: W-What a coincidence! I wanted that too…
Damn you Germans! Just translate your menu so I can read it!
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
